facts.title: AI-drive flags on an ejected bot write into a non-body object
facts.fact: The bot controller sets actor+0x1E8 |= 3 (ma2_bot_ctrl.c:219/231/268/301). That is valid only on MAMech/MAMover bodies. On a NeuroHack-ejected bot, +0x1E8 is an embedded object's vtable pointer. Fixed by ma2_bot_body_ok in actor_ai (push-w1 3fb8ed5, RECOMP_BOT_BODY_GUARD).

facts.title: Signature of a vptr shifted by 3 in [ICALL] lines
facts.fact: A vptr shifted by 3 shows up as [ICALL] targets that are code addresses shifted left 8 bits (0x01ECA000 = 0x0001ECA0, 0x0817E000 = 0x000817E0).

facts.title: The [CS] waits on 0x003C4598 in that log are normal contention (all acquired), not the cause.
facts.fact: The [CS] waits on 0x003C4598 in that log are normal contention (all acquired), not the cause.

facts.title: NeuroHack QTE: setting +0x18 to +0xA8 wins the round
facts.fact: In the NeuroHack QTE, setting the hacker's +0x18 to +0xA8 (target) ends the round as a WIN: the victim is ejected and the 'Mech is left empty. Holding the victim's +0x18 at 0 alone does not win. Test hook RECOMP_TEST_HIJACK (ma2_bots_core.c; hk2/hk3).

facts.title: Bot code must never write unit HP
facts.fact: Writing a unit's HP (+0x260 block +8) from bot code revives units whose death handler already ran. It then crashes later in the deferred-delete walk (B5D60/B5350/B4EF0; hj1-4, hj7). Never write HP, even in test hooks.

facts.title: RECOMP_WATCHDOG_SECS is not a hang detector
facts.fact: RECOMP_WATCHDOG_SECS terminates the process after N seconds (hk1 first launch died at load). It is not a hang detector; use RECOMP_BOT_STALL=1 instead.

facts.title: [ICALL] log lines include ret, ecx, tid and stack words
facts.fact: [ICALL] log lines now include ret, ecx and tid plus 8 stack words (recomp_manual.c recomp_icall_not_code_log, push-w1 aa31817).

facts.title: NeuroHack victim holds a plain MACorporeal placeholder
facts.fact: After a won NeuroHack, the victim's player holds a plain MACorporeal (class CA77C1A6, vtable 00466BA0, 0x1A8 bytes, one child class D8CDB49A) at the 'Mech for about 8-12 s. Deaths +1 at about +9 s, then he respawns about 900 m away as a fresh pilot MAMech. No MAMech/MAMover among the children, so no pilot to drive (w1b-r0.r5). W6b later showed ordinary deaths do not produce it.

facts.title: A won NeuroHack kills the victim
facts.fact: A won NeuroHack kills the victim (deaths +1). The bot does not land as a pilot near the 'Mech.

facts.title: sub_C8E6A first MACorporeal child is the respawn placeholder
facts.fact: sub_C8E6A's 'first MACorporeal child' is the placeholder during the respawn wait. actor_kind now maps exact MACorporeal to MA2_KIND_NONE (ma2_bots_core.c actor_kind, push-w1 fb892dc; switch RECOMP_BOT_PLAIN_CORP, default 1).

facts.title: A write at +0x1E8 on a MACorporeal lands in the next heap block
facts.fact: MACorporeal objects are 0x1A8 bytes (factory 0xD6FE8). Any write at +0x1E8 (MAMover AI flags) on one lands in the next heap block.

facts.title: A human must board an emptied 'Mech on foot
facts.fact: In a BattleArmor, Q climbs out. A human (or test hook) must board an emptied 'Mech on foot.

facts.title: All 4 RECOMP_TEST_HIJACK launches on w1b5 completed a hijack
facts.fact: All 4 RECOMP_TEST_HIJACK launches on w1b5 completed a hijack this time (t=104-179 s). The earlier 'about half' was a W1b hook issue, not a fix issue.

facts.title: Destroyed hijacked 'Mech respawns the human as a pilot
facts.fact: A destroyed hijacked 'Mech sends the human to a fresh pilot (kind 1, hp 10/10) without faults (w1c-r3 t=133-148).

facts.title: UC match start: ensure_nav grid costs 1.1-1.2 s
facts.fact: On UC match start, ensure_nav (ma2_bots_core.c) builds the obstacle grid with 566,702 physics rays: 1.1-1.2 s on the game thread (baseline). trav_fine_props adds about 0.4 s.

facts.title: First bot A* plans hitch the first 4 s of a match
facts.fact: 11 bots x 35-48 ms of A* re-planning together, 3 times in the first 4 s (ctrl_plan, ma2_bot_ctrl.c ~1173; [HITCH-BOT] plan=).

facts.title: RECOMP_HITCH=25 tracer lives in nv2a_pb_exec.c
facts.fact: RECOMP_HITCH=25 tracer lives in nv2a_pb_exec.c (hitch_flip, hitch_sampler). It prints [HITCH-SUM] and [HITCH-S]; resolve RVAs with the .map via w2-runs\hs.py.

facts.title: Loading screen at 10 fps is not match hitching
facts.fact: The loading screen runs at about 10 fps (100 ms frames) for about 1.4 s after bots_level_begin. This is not counted as match hitching.

facts.title: Kernel object edits must be lib-replaced, not just ninja'd
facts.fact: Kernel objects edited (nv2a_pb_exec, nv2a_gpu_d3d11, shader_cache, texture) must be lib-replaced into xbox_kernel.lib (build_w2.cmd). A plain ninja exe does not relink them.

facts.title: Backslash-n collapses in some edit paths
facts.fact: Backslash-n written through some edit paths collapsed in C string escapes. Use the Edit tool for C string escapes.

facts.title: trav_fine_props with budget 0.0 runs the whole pass
facts.fact: trav_fine_props_run(begin=1, budget) ran the whole pass when budget was 0.0 (about 420 ms on UC). A negative budget only sets up (ma2_bots_core.c ~1246/~1470).

facts.title: ma2_trav_commit per turret is now batched
facts.fact: ma2_trav_commit (2 chamfer passes plus component labelling over the grid) costs 9-11 ms on UC and about 24 ms on NRC/BD. turret_seen (ma2_bots_core.c ~2740) called it once per new turret (UC: 6 turrets, 58 ms in one scan). Now batched ([C7] turretbatch).

facts.title: lanes_update first build is the largest match-start hitch
facts.fact: lanes_update first build (3 ma2_path_plan A* plans, ma2_bots_core.c ~3135) costs UC 41-46 ms, BD 74 ms, NRC 231-236 ms in one step, as soon as ma2_trav_ready. It was the largest match-start hitch at the time.

facts.title: Match-start 212-503 ms frame is native, not bot code
facts.fact: Match start (UC/NRC/BD): a 212-503 ms loading-end frame at +0.11.0.15 s is native (HUD .ggf forms, level start, new GPU programs). Only about 21 ms is the first bot tick. BD also waits about 150 ms on a D3D resource fence (sub_0040F510 -> KeWaitForSingleObject) near +0.9 s.

facts.title: Nav slicing timeline at match start
facts.fact: Grid ready about +2.6 s on UC and +4.2 s on NRC/BD. nav_graph_done about +3.4 s UC, +5.4 s NRC, +6.1-6.5 s BD.

facts.title: Baseline worst frame in the first 10 s of a match
facts.fact: Baselines with switches off: worst frame in the first 10 s is 1.4-1.5 s on UC, 3.0 s on NRC, 3.5 s on BD.

facts.title: [HITCH-S] lines list every thread
facts.fact: [HITCH-S] lines list every thread. The game thread is the one with sub_xxxx / ma2_ frames. hs.py handles module names with spaces.

facts.title: The MCP allows 2 games machine-wide
facts.fact: The MCP allows 2 game slots machine-wide.

facts.title: GOAL none with hp=0.00 is a dead bot
facts.fact: A [BOT] line with GOAL none and hp=0.00 is a dead bot lying where it died. The brain tick returns early (ma2_bot_brain.c brain_tick_body ~4470 sets G_NONE). Filter hp>0 before analysing goals.

facts.title: [OBJ-EVT] 'dropped -> home' prints the drop position
facts.fact: [OBJ-EVT] 'dropped -> home' prints the DROP position, not the stand (ma2_bot_objective.c:416-418 prints o->pos). Take the stand from the first '- -> home' event. Bogged Down stands: red flag 495,903, blue flag 870,1735. NRC: 805,1423 and 1077,797.

facts.title: Writing actor+0x4C0 does not teleport a 'Mech
facts.fact: Writing actor+0x4C0 or scene node+0xF0 does not teleport a 'Mech. The node moves for render, but flag touch and collision use another (physics) position (CTF-STAGE test, push-w3, 2026-10-27).

facts.title: Bogged Down CTF capture rate and carrier time
facts.fact: Bogged Down CTF bot matches (5v6, skill 4): 1-3 captures per 300 s. Carriers spend 0.5-6 s inside 25 m of their stand per capture. No orbit above 0.41 turn in 14 carries (w3 runs).

facts.title: Attacker with obj=grab! orbits an enemy stand
facts.fact: An attacker with obj=grab! and goal objective can orbit an enemy stand at 6-15 m for 8-16 s (bd-on1 port 9, t=220-233) with ord=travel eng=0. Cause: controller body-avoidance around hulls on the stand, not combat strafing.

facts.title: CtfCapCommit and CtfGrabCommit switches
facts.fact: Switches [Bots] CtfCapCommit and CtfGrabCommit (default 1); env RECOMP_BOT_CTF_CAP_COMMIT / RECOMP_BOT_CTF_GRAB_COMMIT. Counters [C7] ctfcap / ctfgrab (ma2_bot_brain_obj.c).

facts.title: Guest heap block table grew from holes
facts.fact: xbox_memory_layout.c guest heap block table (g_heap_blocks[65536], address-ordered) accumulated size-0 holes. In a UC bot match it grew from 909 to 3922 entries in 10 min (about 190 frees/s). push-perf b1b908e compacts holes (heap_maybe_compact) and binary-searches frees (heap_floor_index); the table stays near 800-1000.

facts.title: RECOMP_HEAP_RECLAIM is on by default
facts.fact: main.c:169 sets RECOMP_HEAP_RECLAIM=1 by default, so the reclaim (best-fit, hole-skipping) allocator is always the live one.

facts.title: RECOMP_HEAP_CHECK cross-checks heap frees
facts.fact: RECOMP_HEAP_CHECK=1 cross-checks heap free lookups against the linear scan ([HEAP-CHECK] on mismatch). RECOMP_CS_COUNT=1 enables the [CS] enters=/leaves= counters (kernel_rtl.c:435).

facts.title: [HEAP] frees log line period
facts.fact: [HEAP] frees=N matched=N blocks=N prints every 512 matched frees. g_heap_block_count includes holes from before b1b908e.

facts.title: RECOMP_PERF log lines and healthy UC numbers
facts.fact: RECOMP_PERF=1 prints every 5 s '[PERF] fps; GPU draws' and '[PERF-PACING] . over 33.3 ms', plus a '[PERF] CPU phases' line with pack_digest, texture_update and texture_evict (nv2a_pb_exec.c ~125-135, ~530). UC 5v6 after minute 1: texture_update 0, evict 0, pack_digest under 6 ms/min.

facts.title: Back-to-back UC A/B fps is noisy from machine load
facts.fact: Back-to-back UC A/B fps can differ by 15% from machine load alone (other games running). Use the GPU draws_ms line as a quick load check.

facts.title: build_perf.cmd recipe for kernel and apu objects
facts.fact: build_perf.cmd pattern: ninja the changed kernel/apu objects, lib them into xbox_kernel.lib / xbox_apu.lib, delete the exe, then ninja the exe.

facts.title: Carrying bots already use the full 60 m drop limit
facts.fact: A carrying bot already has drop_mode 0 in an earlier pass (ma2_bot_brain.c ~4700: drop_mode = !carrying && .), i.e. the full 60 m drop limit for Mech/BA at normal link cost. drop_pref (W5) only adds cost x0.85, marsh landing and chasers.

facts.title: Bogged Down stand coordinates and marsh paths
facts.fact: Bogged Down (retail ids ED0869FA / user copy A81D8DF7): red stand 495,903 y16; blue stand 870,1735 y23; marsh floor y -20. Stand-to-stand planner paths run 821-924 m via the marsh (PATHTEST, push-w5).

facts.title: Planner drop chain can fail after the first drop
facts.fact: A planner drop chain can fail after the first drop: '[BOT-DROP] could not step off at 876,1610 -- no drops there for 10 min' after steps 878,11 -> 874,6 -> 875,5 -> 872,4 (w5 on2 t=159-170). dropgiveup gives up after 5 s without losing 2 m.

facts.title: Same bot slot gets a different 'Mech speed per run
facts.fact: The same bot slot/port gets a different 'Mech speed per run (32 vs 21 m/s on the same 100 m marsh stretch, off2 vs d1 port 9). Compare carrier path length, not seconds, across runs.

facts.title: Failed launch keeps its game slot; game_files junction target
facts.fact: A test folder's game_files junction must point at R\game_files (the in-game editor folder's game_files lost its xbe).

facts.title: How to rebuild a push-w5 test folder
facts.fact: The test folder 'a test folder' no longer exists and its make_test_folder_w5.ps1 sources are gone. Copy small files from 'a test folder', junction game_files -> R\game_files, and pc_assets -> in-game editor pc_assets.

facts.title: VTOL travel legs use a straight two-point path
facts.fact: vtol_direct_path (ma2_bot_ctrl.c:1112) replaces the ground path with a straight 2-point path when VtolTerrainClimb=1. vtol_prepare (ma2_bot_ctrl.c ~1340) then sets ai+0x20C to 20 m over the highest surface within 220 m ahead (+12 m with a rider).

facts.title: VTOL repair at the helipad needs agl below 6.5 m
facts.fact: A repairs only at agl < 6.5 m and dd < 12 m (ma2_bot_ctrl.c pad block). A VTOL hovers at about 6.6-7.0 m, so Y must be held until agl < 6.5 or the A press never comes.

facts.title: Old pad approach was a spring; heals took 4-7 s
facts.fact: The old pad approach was a spring (stick = 0.025*d - 0.08*v): equilibrium speed 0.3*d, so 8 m/s at 25 m. Heals took 4-7 s, with outliers of 15-34 s on overshoot.

facts.title: vt_ceiling is a learned VTOL height cap
facts.fact: vt_ceiling is a learned absolute VTOL height cap (e.g. 8 m at a marsh spot on Bogged Down while others fly to y 77-96). It expires after 20 s.

facts.title: RECOMP_TEST_VTOL_HURT and RECOMP_BOT_PADTRACE hooks
facts.fact: Test hook RECOMP_TEST_VTOL_HURT (ma2_bots_core.c:4659) and RECOMP_BOT_PADTRACE. [C7] vtpad heal_total_s / healed_n gives the seconds per heal.

facts.title: Test folders lose junction dirs; game reports Cannot open XBE
facts.fact: Test folders occasionally lose their junction dirs (game_files, pc_assets). The game then prints 'Cannot open XBE: game_files\ma2.xbe'.

facts.title: on1b crash: null ICALL, pure virtual, AV in scene-render walk
facts.fact: on1b crash signature: a null [ICALL], then 2x R6025 pure virtual with heap-address [ICALL] targets (0x0248D1A0, 0x024B2020), then an AV at RVA 0x829120 with eax=0x74736E49 ('Inst' bytes where a vptr should be). The guest stack is in the scene-render node walk (sub_8C5B0 family): a freed or overwritten scene object, not bot logic (w6\).

facts.title: NeuroHack placeholder is rare in CTF; ordinary deaths do not produce it
facts.fact: In Bogged Down CTF bot matches the NeuroHack placeholder (plain MACorporeal, [C7] bodyguard plain=) appeared in 1 of 4 runs (on2, plain=828, after 1 hack). None across 19-30 deaths per run in the others, so ordinary deaths do NOT produce it. This corrects W1b's guess (w6b on1-on4).

facts.title: push-w1 merged into push-w6 runs stay clean
facts.fact: With push-w1 merged into push-w6 (6dd9e3e), 4/4 ON runs had 0 [ICALL], 0 faults and 0 bodyguard skips. The guard never fired; the plain= counter is the path that matters.

facts.title: RECOMP_TEST_VTOL_HURT cannot revive dead units
facts.fact: RECOMP_TEST_VTOL_HURT only lowers HP on live bot VTOLs (skips when hp <= frac*max+1), so it cannot revive a dead unit (ma2_bots_core.c:4862-4878). Its slot table holds 8 VTOL actors with no reuse after that.

facts.title: [BOT] t= lines need RECOMP_BOT_DIAG
facts.fact: [BOT] t= lines are not printed without RECOMP_BOT_DIAG. Wait scripts should key on '[C7] c3 . t=N' lines, which come every 30 s.

facts.title: Path search is now begin/run/finish with sliced queues
facts.fact: Path search was one function, ma2_path_plan (ma2_bot_path.c). It is now begin/run/finish (305/:367/:475) plus ma2_pathq_* queues (598-) for sliced plans. ctx0 is sync, ctx1 the sliced job. ma2_bot_path.c has its own QPC clock (pq_now_ms).

facts.title: PathSlice switch and lane-build state machine
facts.fact: [Bots] PathSlice / RECOMP_BOT_PATH_SLICE (default on), RECOMP_BOT_PATH_SLICE_MS (6), C7 pathslice. Bots take their route in ctrl_plan_take (ma2_bot_ctrl.c:1225). Lane build is the lanes_build_run state machine (ma2_bots_core.c:3197); lanes publish only when all plans are done.

facts.title: Plan cost and lane build wall time when sliced
facts.fact: Plan cost as job work: UC 45 ms, NRC 84 ms max per plan. Lane build wall time: UC 162-194 ms, NRC 737 ms when sliced at 6 ms per step.

facts.title: Sliced plan equals synchronous plan on NRC
facts.fact: RECOMP_BOT_PATHTEST_SLICE=1 with RECOMP_BOT_PATHTEST prints [PATHTEST-SLICE] same=. The sliced plan equals the synchronous plan, 14/14 on NRC.

facts.title: nv2a_gpu_d3d11.c needs a generated nv2a_gpu_shader.h
facts.fact: nv2a_gpu_d3d11.c needs the generated nv2a_gpu_shader.h (CMake from nv2a_gpu.hlsl via nv2a_gpu_shader.h. escaping as '.\n"').

facts.title: BOT-TRAPPED definition and heavy tail
facts.fact: BOT-TRAPPED = c->stalls >= 4 (stall = no 3 m progress for 6 s; 2.5 s on a boarding leg), ma2_bot_ctrl.c ~2026. Heavy-tailed: one bot looping (nrc-s2 23, nrcctf-s2 41, uc-after1 3).

facts.title: Where the W7 pathing runs and scripts are
facts.fact: W7 are in push-perf-pathing\w7\ (nrc-before1, uc-after1, nrc-pathtest, etc. stalls.py, w7wait.sh, make_test_folder_w7.ps1).
